   11      if reduction not in _REDUCTIONS:
   12          raise ValueError(f"reduction must be one of {_REDUCTIONS}, got {reduction!r}")
   13      BT, V = p.shape
   14      q = q.detach()  # constant target: no gradient flows to q
   15  
   16      tvd = 0.5 * torch.abs(p - q)  # (BT, V)
   17  
   18      if shift_labels is None:
   19          n_rows = BT
   20      else:
   21          keep = shift_labels != ignore_index  # (BT,)
   22          tvd = torch.where(keep.unsqueeze(1), tvd, torch.zeros_like(tvd))
   23          n_rows = int(keep.sum().item())
   24  
   25      if reduction == "none":
   26          return tvd
   27      total = tvd.sum()
   28      if reduction == "sum":
   29          return total
   30      if n_rows == 0:
   31          raise ValueError(f"reduction={reduction!r} needs at least one row whose label is not ignore_index")
   32      if reduction == "mean":
   33          return total / (n_rows * V)
   34      return total / n_rows  # batchmean
